_note: The chat's words in English. Variables: {customer} {item} {qty} {amount} {deal} {supplier} {screen} {msg} {to} {from} {secs}
order_in: {customer} wants {qty} of {item} — I'll prepare a quotation
to_warehouse: {to}, sales order {deal} for {customer}: {qty} {item} — do we have it in stock?
{to}, can you check the balance of {item} for order {deal}?
stock_ok: We have it, {to} — preparing the issue for order {deal}
The balance is enough, issuing {qty} {item} now
stock_short: Not enough {item}, {to} — we need to buy
We're short, I'll tell purchasing about order {deal}
to_purchasing: {to}, we need {qty} {item} for order {deal} — please raise a purchase order
{to}, {item} ran out, we need to order from the supplier
po_done: Purchase order placed with {supplier} — arriving today
goods_in: The goods from {supplier} arrived and I received them
to_sales_invoice: {to}, {qty} {item} issued for order {deal} — please invoice it
{to}, the goods are out, the invoice is yours
to_accountant: {to}, invoice {deal} for {customer} at {amount} — please review the entry
{to}, I invoiced {customer}, have a look at the entry
to_manager: Mr. {to}, invoice {deal} at {amount} needs your approval
{to}, there's an invoice above the approval limit ({amount})
to_cashier: {to}, {customer} will pay {amount} for invoice {deal} — please make the receipt voucher
done_deal: We finished {deal} from order to collection
fail_ask: {to}, the system won't take it in {screen}: “{msg}” — what should I do?
{to}, I've been stuck in {screen} for a while, it keeps saying “{msg}”
fail_reply: Try again, and if it keeps doing that we'll tell support
Leave it for now, we'll talk to the developers
That's a known issue, report it to technical support
slow: The system is really slow in {screen}
I've been waiting for {screen} for {secs} seconds
busy: I've got a pile of work, give me a moment
I can't keep up, there are {n} tasks ahead of me
no_permission: I don't have permission for {screen} — who can do it?
The system says I have no permission in {screen}
wrong_data: The numbers don't add up in {screen} — {msg}
evening: Time to go, have a nice evening
closing: I closed the accounts for the day
manager_report: Today we sold {amount} — thank you, team
to_accountant_pi: {to}, we received {item} from {supplier} — please record the purchase invoice
{to}, the invoice from {supplier} came with the goods
dup_delete: I made the quotation twice for {customer} — deleting the duplicate
There's a duplicate quotation, deleting it
customer_change: {customer} called and wants to change the quantity on invoice {deal}
Customer {customer} is asking for a change to the invoice
to_review_edit: {to}, I edited invoice {deal} — please review the entry again
{to}, invoice {deal} was changed, check the entry
order_in_real: A new customer request came in — entering the quotation on the system
A customer called asking for a quotation, I'm making it on NQ ERP now
